issue.title: bob-mac-capture macOS CI: testQueuedCodeKeyCopiesWhenCatalogReturns fails on every master run since c7a5f37
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `BobMacCaptureTests.RefsPanelModelTests/testQueuedCodeKeyCopiesWhenCatalogReturns`

bob-mac-capture macOS CI has failed this test on every master run since c7a5f37
("feat(refs): wire Copy card code picker and preview well", bob-cli-cc.9): runs
40365325905 (c7a5f37), 40376353485 (bdeb4aa), 40383389151 (d05f5a5), and 40384861340
(591e4fe). On 591e4fe it is the only failing test in the 3147-test suite.

Failure (RefsPanelModelTests.swift:1421 and :1425): after `c` queues the code picker
and Return is pressed before the delayed catalog (80 ms) returns, the pasteboard gets
the 3-line makefile block (`build:\n\tswift build\n\tswift test`) instead of the
14-line yaml `refresh:` block, and the confirmation reads "Copied makefile · 3 lines"
instead of "Copied yaml · 14 lines".

Deterministic, not a flake: identical assertion values on four consecutive runs across
three different SHAs. Decide whether the queued-Return default-selection policy
regressed or the expectation (fixture order in `codeResponse`) is outdated, record the
evidence, then fix that side without weakening the assertions. The Mac host has only
Command Line Tools (no XCTest): verify via `just portable-check`, the scratch
`bundle.sh` + `just typecheck-tests` run on the mac, then master CI.

Found by the batch-14 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.6.land) while checking
macOS CI for bob-cli-ci. Owning epic bob-cli-cc closed at 2026-10-26T19:10Z without
recording it.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Identical assertion values (makefile block instead of yaml block) on four consecutive master runs across three SHAs: 40365325905, 40376353485, 40383389151, 40384861340.

issue.creation_reason: It is now the only red test on bob-mac-capture master CI, and its owning epic bob-cli-cc closed without recording it.
